choose.when:
select no as resourceNo, 'course' as resourceType, 1 as productType, id as productId, title as productName, ifnull(price, 0.00) as price, ifnull(t_price, price) as originalPrice from osh_course where delete_flag = 0 and status = 4 and level = 2 and no is not null and no != ''
and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by create_time desc, id desc

select no as resourceNo, 'book' as resourceType, 2 as productType, id as productId, title as productName, ifnull(price, 0.00) as price, ifnull(original_price, price) as originalPrice from osh_book where delete_flag = 0 and status = '0' and level = 2 and no is not null and no != ''
and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by create_time desc, id desc
choose.otherwise: select null as resourceNo, null as resourceType, null as productType, null as productId, null as productName, null as price, null as originalPrice where 1 = 0
